hookText: The 24 Best Books for Math Teachers, in Reading Order

beats.say: What to read if you teach mathematics, from why the subject is worth teaching to how children learn it and what to do on Monday morning.
24 books in five steps, three of them free. In a hurry Before the books Step I · Books 01-04 Four short books about what mathematics is for.
Step II · Books 05-09 Five books of research, written to be read by teachers.
